messages:
lee_support: FYI escalation -> customer 'PolarisDocs' (trial) cannot accept org invites. Provisioning says complete but admin never received magic link. Trial ends in 5 days, they're trying to book an exec demo. Ticket #75421. tagging CS for priority handover.
nora_csm: thanks. can you paste the support link and any SMTP/trace details? also any customer note about corporate email blocklists?
lee_support: ticket: https://redwood-support/75421. traces: outbound accepted by their MX, subsequent TCP reset from their mail gateway. SPF/DKIM clean. customer mentions strict filtering for external links.
tariq_eng: seeing same: remote host closing connection after DATA. could be gateway rejecting based on URL patterns. no bounce to us.
nora_csm: ok. plan suggestion: 1) CSM outreach to admin with signed PDF invite + manual invite code (to bypass link click), 2) schedule enablement session <48h to verify SSO roles and demo flows, 3) apply temporary demo org with bypass invites and increase seats for demo. also loop AE (nora_ae).
lee_support: support suggested text for CSM to use (can copy):
```
Hi <Admin>,\nWe detected your mail gateway blocking the invite link. As a workaround you can either add no-reply@redwood.ai to your allowlist or use this manual invite code: POLAR-INV-9d2f (valid 72h). If you prefer, we can send a signed PDF copy of the invite or host a short screen-share to complete role setup.\nBest,\nLee (Support)
```
nora_csm: will take outreach. Nora_AE, want to join the enablement call so exec demo timing is aligned? Also I'll note renewal risk as "watch" and create a 3-day follow-up task in Gainsight.
nora_ae: joining. please CC me on the outreach and ping if they confirm the exec date. I can prep demo slides tailored to their compliance questions.
tariq_eng: I'll join the call to walk SAML attribute mapping and share a minimal SCIM patch to avoid link-based invites. I'll prepare a 2-step runbook.
ops-bot: ticket #75421 -> escalated to customer-success. SLA: 24h.
lee_support: sent the suggested text into ticket and flagged for CSM. customer replied: they prefer manual invite code and asked for a 30-min SSO walkthrough tomorrow morning.
nora_csm: booked 9am PT tomorrow. Actions: nora_csm send manual invite + signed PDF, nora_ae on demo alignment, tariq_eng on SSO/SCIM, lee_support keep ticket traces attached. I'll apply demo org per PM approval and mark Gainsight task.
nora_ae: acknowledged. I'll prep a short compliance appendix for execs.
tariq_eng: prepping runbook now. will paste post-call troubleshooting steps to the ticket.
lee_support: keeping ticket open until post-call success. closing slack thread for now but will update if anything changes.
